L107: cite28†Image: The Gritti Palace Venice L108: # Welcome to The Gritti Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Venice
L109: ## Live the Grand Canal lifestyle at our 5-star hotel in Venice
L110: Set on the Grand Canal in the Venice city center near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco, The Gritti Palace boasts one of the most enthralling views of the lagoon - from S. Giorgio Maggiore and Punta della Dogana to S. Maria della Salute Basilica and the Peggy Guggenheim Collection. Dating to 1475, this noble palace and luxury hotel in Venice is a place of exceptional art and elegance that has retained its reassuringly intimate and familiar feel of a private residence.
L111: A historical treasure where heritage and culture blend with renewed Venetian style, our 5-star hotel in Venice is a refined version of its iconic self, offering attentive service, a delectable culinary experience and new avenues for relaxation and pleasure.
L112: From the design of its signature suites and iconic terraces to the Gritti Epicurean School, Riva Yacht experiences, Riva Lounge and the Gritti SPA branded by Sisley Paris, The Gritti Palace is where generations of elite global influencers gather to explore, taste and celebrate.
L113: Venice’s Most Iconic View
L114: 
L115: Discover the Venice of grand romances and enduring beauty. From The Gritti Palace’s exclusive terraces overlooking the Grand Canal, savor unforgettable moments, sunset aperitivo, and spectacular views in one of the world’s most iconic destinations.
L116: ### Rooms and Suites

L118: ## Offers & Packages

L120: ### Signature Suite Collection
L121: 
L122: The epitome of luxury, the Gritti Signature Suite Collection showcases the hotel’s rich historical past. Redesigned with artistic elegance, the suites evoke the intimacy of a noble private residence and provide a truly distinctive experience that uniquely captures the heritage of the palace and the Cultural and Artistic roots of the city.
L123: ## Grand Canal View Suites
L124: 
L125: Boasting the most desirable views of the lively Grand Canal, and the city's largest rooftop terrace, the suites are inspired by past illustrious guests of the hotel, and city landmarks and festivals.

L131: Unfold the Hotel Heritage
L132: ### Hotel History
L133: 
L134: From its beginnings our palazzo has been home to a rich collection of artworks, a tradition that originated with the noble Pisani family, and that continued with its successive owners including the Gritti’s.
L135: ## An Intriguing History
L136: The Gritti Palace dates back to 1475 when the Pisani family, who lived here, transformed it into its current Gothic shape. In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti, and in the centuries that followed, it was home to other noble families and illustrious visitors. It was at the beginning of the XIX century that The Gritti Palace was turned into a hotel and after a meticulous renovation it now offers guests an insight into its intriguing and illustrious past.
L137: Admire the refined renovation from the beautiful terrazzo floors to the remarkable selection of artworks and antiques that adorn all private and social spaces within the hotel.
L138: cite31†Image: Explorer's Library†cache.marriott.com L139: ## Illustrious Guests
L140: 
L141: Over the years, The Gritti Palace has welcomed many famous guests. It was home to successive noble families, such as the Pisanis and again the Grittis in 1814. Some years later it was sold to the Baroness Susanna d'Eyb, widow to the Baron Vetzlar. It was during this period that John Ruskin and his young wife Effie spent a long period at Palazzo Gritti where he wrote his famous book 'The Stones of Venice'.

L150: A 15th century palazzo, private residence to noble families and illustrious visitors, and luxury hotel since 1895, The Gritti Palace is where history and culture meet with renewed Venetian style.

L154: 
L155: A place of exceptional art and elegance, reassuringly intimate with a homely feel, The Gritti Palace is where multiple generations of elite global influencers gather to socialize, draw inspiration, and celebrate.

Discover the Venetian archipelago’s heritage and the beautiful panoramas of the northern and southern lagoons with our selection of tailored excursions. L109: # Welcome to The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort
L110: ## Cultivate Relaxation in the Maldives
L111: Surrounded by verdant rainforest and white-sand beaches on a private island, The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort overlooks the alluring waves of the Indian Ocean. Explore the tropical beauty and rich marine life of this peaceful, eco-conscious setting. Our private lagoon, Iridium Spa, and outdoor infinity pool promise nonpareil relaxation. A large variety of water sports, diving, and excursions at our luxury resort in the Maldives can be arranged by our signature butler service.
L112: In addition, exquisite culinary fare awaits at our seven restaurants and bars. Boasting refined furnishings and island-inspired design, each of the 33 on-land and 44 over-water luxury private villas at our island resort in the Maldives promises picturesque ocean or garden views from private terraces and pools. Our legendary St. Regis Butlers deliver bespoke service day or night.

L115: Begin your festive escape with advance reservation privileges of up to 30% savings, breakfast inclusive, resort credit, island experiences, and the legendary St. Regis Butler Service throughout your stay. Reserve now.

L194: St. Regis Rituals

L196: Champagne Sabering
L197: As the sun sets over the Indian Ocean, The Whale Bar comes alive with the celebrated art of Champagne Sabering. Inspired by a tradition attributed to Napoleon Bonaparte, who famously opened bottles of champagne with a saber in both victory and defeat, this signature St. Regis ritual marks the transition from day to evening with ceremony, elegance, and a toast to life's finest moments.
L198: 
L199: Afternoon Tea
L200: Inspired by the legacy of Caroline Astor and the celebrated gatherings of New York's Gilded Age, Afternoon Tea remains a timeless St. Regis tradition. Guests are invited to savor a refined selection of teas, delicate pastries, and meaningful conversation in an atmosphere of timeless elegance.
L201: 
L202: Island Mary
L203: The Island Mary is The St. Regis Maldives Vommuli Resort's signature interpretation of the iconic St. Regis Bloody Mary tradition. Infused with flavors inspired by the destination, this distinctive elixir captures the spirit of Vommuli Island while celebrating a ritual enjoyed at St. Regis hotels around the world.
L204: 
L205: St. Regis Butler Service
L206: The hallmark of the St. Regis experience, the Butler Service ensures every stay unfolds with effortless ease. From pre-arrival arrangements and bespoke itineraries to dining reservations, restorative rituals, and special celebrations, every detail is thoughtfully curated to individual preferences.
L207: For more than a century, St. Regis Butlers have anticipated guests' needs with discretion and precision. L106: ## A Luxury Private Desert Escape, Inspired by Bedouin Spirit
L107: Nestled within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa is one of the most exclusive luxury desert resorts in Dubai, offering an immersive escape into the heart of the Arabian desert. Surrounded by rolling golden dunes and lush palm groves, this award-winning Dubai 5-star resort features 42 private pool villas, each with panoramic views of the pristine desert landscape.
L108: Explore endemic wildlife and flora through guided wildlife drives, horse rides, camel treks, nature walks, archery, falconry, and heritage experiences, with free-roaming oryx and gazelles adding to the sense of place. L354: Old men told of this place where water flowed from a rock, the perpetual spring fed by ancient underground lakes. Birds gathered in the dense trees, Gazelle hid from the shimmering heat under matted palms, and occasionally even the hardened, elusive Arabian Leopard was seen in the distant mountains.
L355: The desert is an unforgiving place to those who cannot read its signs or understand its subtle warnings. Without the grasses or the palms, the vengeful sands first covered the dry rock pools, then smothered the trees, and finally buried the encampment that had strangled the flow of water from the rock.
L356: Through generations, young adventurers were lost in the shifting sand as they searched for signs of Al Maha. Many trekked over the buried place, only to fall next to their exhausted camels, a noble fate at the end of a fruitless journey.
L357: Confounded by the disobedience of his hunting falcon, a young man followed his bird's movements over the dunes, only to find it perched on a thin branch protruding through the sand. Approaching the bird, the young man's anger turned to curiosity when he noticed small green leaves sprouting from the slender branch. Knowing this was a sure sign of water below, the youth and his brothers later returned to the same place and together they dug away the layers of time.
L358: Finally, after removing a stout wedge in a rocky ledge, the brothers watched as water bubbled out and began to wash the sands away, revealing the ancient walls of the camp. Soon, the lost oasis reformed.

L103: ## Expect luxury in Peru's Sacred Valley
L104: Discover an unparalleled luxury experience at Tambo del Inka, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Valle Sagrado. Our hotel in Sacred Valley, Urubamba, Peru, offers stunning views of the Andes Mountains and the Vilcanota River. Relax in elegant rooms and suites, savor authentic Peruvian cuisine crafted with local ingredients and produce from our organic garden, and rejuvenate at our spa, heated indoor pool, and fitness center.
L105: Adventure, culture, and wellness come together at our luxury Sacred Valley hotel and an unforgettable destination.

L103: # Welcome to JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge
L104: ## A Serene Escape in the heart of Masai Mara
L105: JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge marks the debut of the brand's first Luxury Safari Lodge. Overlooking the Talek River and Masai Mara National Reserve, our safari hotel is set on community land. The Masai Mara lodge features 24 luxurious tented suites, including a two-tent family suite, each with a private outdoor Jacuzzi tub and deck.
L106: For luxury safari travelers, experiences include JW Garden meals, bush meals during Game Drives, a Canon photography studio, holistic wellness at the Spa by JW, fitness center and an outdoor pool. Relax at Sarabi Restaurant, Fig Tree Lounge, or the outdoor viewing deck with a fire pit, enjoying serene spaces throughout the lodge. We also offer airstrip transfers, culinary experiences, specialty meals and meaningful moments in one of the finest Masai Mara Lodges.
L107: For the safety and comfort of our guests we have age restrictions for children under six.

L188: African Dynamism
L189: ## A Signature Moment Rooted in Heritage Brought to Life Through Connection
L190: African Dynamism refers to the vibrant, evolving, and adaptive nature of Africa. This concept highlights the continent's ability to integrate diverse influences and maintain cultural richness despite changing times. This dynamism is evident in various aspects in African culture including beadwork. Beadwork in Africa dates back to prehistoric times, with early beads made from shells, bones and stones serving as symbols of identity, status, and heritage.
L191: Today, the unique colours, shapes and material, reflects an individualism exactly like nothing else. In many cultures, giving beads as a gift to a guest is a gesture of hospitality, respect, and goodwill. This tradition reflects the deep-rooted values of community and connection.That is why every African Pride guest is gifted a beaded item personally crafted by the hotel staff conveying a unique cultural narrative.They are not just souvenirs but symbols of African Pride hospitality.

L107: # Welcome to The St. Regis New York
L108: ## Stay at our iconic luxury hotel in Midtown NYC
L109: Founded by John Jacob Astor IV over a century ago, The St. Regis New York is one of Midtown Manhattan's best luxury hotels. Our five-star hotel on NYC's Fifth Avenue reflects the rich heritage of St. Regis and its timeless elegance. Every element is considered, from richly decorated rooms and designer suites to graceful public spaces and a regal rooftop ballroom with sweeping city views.
L110: Luxury two-bedroom hotel suites make our New York City, Manhattan hotel ideal for families seeking a five-star experience in the Big Apple. Located at Fifth Avenue and 55th Street in Midtown Manhattan, our hotel is steps from Central Park, Fifth Avenue Shopping, MoMa, and the Rockefeller Center. Enjoy luxury amenities, including treasured St. Regis Butler Service, and explore New York City in style from our Fifth Avenue address.
L111: ### Reimagined Guestrooms & Suites
L112: 
L113: Distinctive in design and rooted in legacy, each guestroom and suite reveals a curated interplay of jewel-toned textiles, polished brass accents, and rich marble finishes, creating a residential sense of quiet elegance. Now unveiled as part of the hotel’s next chapter, these refined accommodations balance heritage and modern comfort at New York’s most storied Fifth Avenue address.

L148: cite34†Image: NYC Themed Sugar Cookies†cache.marriott.com L149: ## St. Regis Butler Service
L150: 
L151: When John Jacob Astor IV first conceived the St. Regis New York, his vision was to create "the finest hotel in the world.” As such, the St. Regis butler was born out of a mandate to fulfill every guest’s desire as if it were second nature.

L155: Signature Services
L156: St. Regis Butler Service is a treasured hallmark of the St. Regis hotel experience, and has been for over a century. During your stay, you'll enjoy the careful attention of a personal butler, who will assist you with everything from a perfectly pressed suit for an important business meeting to thoughtful last-minute gifts from local NYC boutiques - as well as luxury perks such as curated books for nighttime reading. St.
L157: Regis Butler Service is dedicated to understanding and addressing your unique preferences and fulfilling every detail, no matter how small, for the duration of your time with us in Midtown Manhattan.
L158: Beverage Services
L159: Upon arrival, allow a St. Regis Butler to arrange coffee or tea service in your room. And if you wish, a St. Regis butler will arrive after your morning wake-up call to draw your shades, deliver your coffee or tea as well as the day’s newspaper and weather forecast.
L160: Unpacking & Packing Services
L161: Allow a St. Regis Butler to take care of the unpacking and storage of your luggage—so that you can relax and settle in for your stay. Similarly, before you depart, simply contact the butler service desk to dispatch a Butler to assist with gathering and folding your garments to prepare your luggage for the journey home.
L162: Garment Pressing
L163: Once unpacked, simply let your St. Regis Butler know which garments require pressing and they will be pleased to assist, returning the garments to your wardrobe promptly. This service includes pressing of two garments per person, upon arrival.

L165: eButler Services
L166: During your stay, whether you are inside or outside the hotel, a St. Regis Butler is accessible at any hour via email. Simply send your request to newyork.butler@stregis.com and allow the Butler Service Desk to assist.

L100: # Welcome to JW Marriott El Convento Cusco
L101: ## Experience the distinctive luxury of our Cusco hotel
L102: Expect a one-of-a-kind stay at JW Marriott El Convento Cusco. Our Cusco historic Center hotel sits within the city center and offers a blend of historic grandeur and modern comforts. Find us housed inside a restored 16th-century convent. Our luxury hotel in Cusco features two exhibition halls filled with ancient Peruvian artifacts. Explore Plaza de Armas or take a train ride to Machu Picchu from our hotel in Cusco, Peru, which offers easy access to many other attractions in Peru.
L103: Then retreat to a renovated hotel room or suite with oxygen-enrichment systems that help relieve altitude sickness. Awake refreshed before you head over to our spa for a treatment based on centuries-old Incan healing regimens. When hunger strikes, visit Qespi Restaurant and Bar, considered one of the best restaurants in Cusco, Peru, for an elegant atmosphere and fresh, local dishes. Luxury and mysticism await you at JW Marriott El Convento Cusco.

L128: ### Historic Grandeur
L129: 
L130: Housed in a restored 16th-century convent in the heart of Cusco's historic center, our luxury hotel features two exhibition halls with ancient Peruvian artifacts.
L131: ## Exhibition Hall
L132: Recognizing the historical significance of the Killke remains discovered on the property, the artifacts were carefully recovered and preserved within the hotel. Beyond revealing the earliest origins of Cusco, these findings helped substantiate important theories about the city's development.
L133: They demonstrated that, when the Incas established Cusco as their capital in the 12th century, they settled among existing cultures rather than in an uninhabited region, subsequently assimilating and building upon these earlier societies.
L134: cite14†Learn More L135: 
L136: cite24†Image: Exhibition Hall†cache.marriott.com L137: ## Front Desk
L138: Representing Inti, the revered Inca Sun God, this remarkable artwork welcomes guests in our historic hotel in Cusco's first entrance and reception area.
L139: Specially commissioned for the space, the spectacular Swarovski light installation, crafted in Austria, takes the form of a radiant sun measuring 3.20 meters in diameter and composed of more than 76,500 crystals.Inspired by one of the most powerful symbols of Inca culture, it pays tribute to Inti's central role in the Andean worldview, where the sun was revered as a source of life, prosperity, and divine power, a legacy that continues to inspire to this day.
L140: cite14†Learn More L141: 
L142: cite25†Image: Reception†cache.marriott.com L143: ## Excellence in Every Detail
L144: Old Augustinian Convent located in one of the thousand-year-old cities such as Cusco, where history is evident in every corner. It symbolizes and represents a current work, carried out in accordance with existing regulations and under strict conservation criteria, where it allows us to glimpse the various historical moments of this city, Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
L145: At the JW Marriott Cusco, a Cusco Exhibition Hall of approximately 228 m2 and another dedicated to the Killke civilization have been enabled so that guests can directly appreciate those archaeological remains so revealing.
L146: cite26†Image: Courtyard†cache.marriott.com L147: ### Authentic Peruvian Fine Dining

L103: cite20†Image: Luxury Collection Hotels L104: # Welcome to Hotel Marqués de Riscal, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Elciego
L105: ## Visionary Architecture, Vintage Experiences.
L106: This stunning 21st-century chateau was designed by internationally renowned architect Frank O. Gehry and is a true masterpiece. Located in the Marqués de Riscal City of Wine, this hotel with a spa in Rioja Alavesa is truly an adventure of a lifetime. Prepare to savor a one-of-a-kind experience for all the senses at our Elciego hotel. New delights await.
L107: Enjoy local cuisine and fine wines at 1860 Tradicion or Marques de Riscal Restaurant, both overseen by Michelin-starred Chef Francis Paniego, or soak up the benefits of the grape at the Vinothérapie SPA Caudalie Marqués de Riscal. Welcome to the only hotel created by Frank O. Gehry, where each of the unique 61 guestrooms and suites promises to enchant with exceptional designer touches and enviable views of the countryside, the medieval town of Elciego or the striking architecture.

L129: cite26†Image: Exterior†cache.marriott.com L130: ### The Art of Gehry
L131: 
L132: One of the most ambitious projects among Spanish wine cellars to date, The Marqués de Riscal City of Wine was designed to create a world of sensations for wine and architecture aficionados. It spans an area of almost 100,000 square metres, consisting of the Marqués de Riscal cellars, the dramatic hotel, two restaurants, a spa, roof top lounge, wine bar, a wine shop and meeting and banqueting areas.
L133: 
L134: cite27†Image: Exterior†cache.marriott.com L135: ### Visionary Architecture
L136: 
L137: For the hotel's creation, the winery envisioned an ultra-modern building that would evoke strong emotions. To achieve this effect, Frank O. Gehry was selected. Over a glass of wine from the architect's year of birth, 1929—the team laid out their ideas for the project. Mr. Gehry was seduced by the challenge of designing a hotel located in the heart of a wine cellar, something he had never done before.
L138: 
L139: cite28†Image: Winery The Cathedral†cache.marriott.com L140: ### Hotel History
L141: 
L142: Construction of the original cellars began in 1858, the year the winery was founded. Inside these installations, guests will find the 'Cathedral,' a bottle cellar in which Marqués de Riscal guards its greatest treasure—a priceless collection of bottles from nearly every vintage since the winery's founding. Hotel celebrated its Grand Opening in October 2006.

L203: Details
L204: Our Luxury Collection Concierge team at the Hotel Marques de Riscal sets an exemplary standard of service 24 hours a day, seven days a week. From behind-the-scenes cultural tours at nearby wineries to private golf outings, they will handle every request with efficiency and aplomb. Turn to them for limousine services, flower deliveries, restaurant reservations, directions, general information and more.
L205: In addition to the Hotel Marques de Riscal Winery, our Concierge recommends the following as unique places to explore in the local area:
L206:   * Visit other important wineries from the area such as Ysios, C.V.N.E., and El Fabulista, and learn more about the history of wine at the excellent Dinastia Vivanco Wine Museum.
L207:   * Travel back in time with tours of the medieval towns of Elciego and Laguardia. Marvel first-hand at the inspiration for Ken Follett's book "The World without Ending": The spectacular Santa Maria Cathedral in Vitoria city.
L208:   * Walk in the footsteps of millions of pilgrims through history by traversing the celebrated spiritual road towards Santiago de Compostela.
L209:   * Indulge the taste buds with a delicious visit to Logroño city's Laurel tapas street.
L210:   * Tour the monastery Monasterio de Yuso and Suso—a UNESCO’s World Heritage site and the birthplace of the Spanish language.
L211:   * If time allows, do not miss a trip to Bilbao to discover Frank Gehry's other architectural masterpiece in Spain—the Guggenheim Museum

L108: # Welcome to W Barcelona
L109: ## Dive into the current
L110: Step inside. See for yourself. Designed by world-renowned architect Ricardo Bofill, W Barcelona sets the scene for a spectacular stay in Barcelona. As a luxury spa hotel with 473 fabulous guestrooms and suites, it offers a combination of impeccable service and comfort and is located on the beachfront along the famous Barceloneta Boardwalk. Each guestroom and suite of this Barcelona luxury hotel on the beach provides panoramic views over the Mediterranean Sea and the city of Barcelona.
L111: ### Evolving From Within
L112: From October 26 through late spring 2027, W Barcelona will enter the second phase of its transformation. Following the complete renovation of the rooms and suites within the iconic “Sail” building, including all nine Premium Suites, among them the Penthouse Suite on the 25th floor and the two Gaudí-inspired Onada Terrace Suites, the focus will now shift to the ground-floor public spaces and guestrooms located on floors 1 through 6.
L113: Throughout this period, COYA, located on the mezzanine level, and NOXE, on the 26th floor, will remain open to welcome guests. As these spaces evolve, we will continue to ensure a seamless arrival experience and a memorable stay, with our service thoughtfully reimagined around this temporary guest journey.
L114: Completing the hotel's comprehensive renewal, this final phase further deepens W Barcelona's connection to the culture, creativity, and spirit of Barcelona, as the icon unfolds into an even more inspiring version of itself.

L110: ## Experience luxury in Soho at our 5 star hotel
L111: Discover a new generation of luxury at The London EDITION, a luxury hotel set in a historic building moments from Mayfair, Soho, Covent Garden and West End theatres. For luxury travellers and couples’ city breaks, this hotel near Soho, London pairs elegant design with a central base for theatre, shopping and dining. Immaculately appointed luxury hotel rooms and suites feature a nautical theme, distinctive accents, complimentary Wi-Fi, rainforest showers and modern technology.
L112: Savour seasonal British cuisine at Berners Tavern, critically acclaimed chef Jason Atherton's stylish restaurant with a private dining room for special occasions. Unwind with drinks at the modern Lobby Bar or award-winning Punch Room. Guests praise the attentive service, chic atmosphere, comfortable beds and walkable location. If you're comparing venues in 5-star hotels in London, England, our adaptable spaces and catering services place the best of the city at your fingertips.

L104: ## Explore the beautifully uncharted in Hobart, Tasmania.
L105: Tasmania's natural, culinary and creative treasures are within easy reach at our award-winning 5-star hotel in Hobart, The Tasman. Anchored to the waterfront precinct and in the embrace of kunanyi/Mount Wellington, Australia's first Luxury Collection hotel sits comfortably between Hobart's CBD, picturesque Derwent harbour, MONA Ferry terminal and the iconic Salamanca Place and Battery Point neighbourhoods.
L106: In a showcase of understated elegance by design, The Tasman is an architectural symphony; an overture of 1840s Georgian heritage, building to 1940s Art Deco and a 2020s modern extension finale. Original sandstone contrasts spectacularly with a glass-encased prism of modern architecture.
L107: Unique Accommodation
L108: ### Three Eras of Design
L109: A 5-star Hobart CBD hotel of architectural distinction, The Tasman Hobart celebrates the city’s natural maritime advantage. Like a seafarer’s rope, it is a woven story of local materials and luxury finishes that seamlessly tie together three eras of design. In the Heritage building, original Georgian details have been restored and reimagined. Rooms feature original windows, restored fireplaces, original artwork, and custom furnishings. The St.
L110: David’s Park Suite, the crown jewel of the heritage building, overlooks its namesake park and features a lofty ceiling reminiscent of the first ships arriving in Hobart, exposed sandstone walls, and original artwork. Art Deco rooms are a vision of luxury with rich colors and materials and Blackheart Sassafras ceilings. Within the contemporary Pavilion building, rooms feature sweeping water views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
L111: The premier suite is Aurora Suite, with its spectacular outdoor terrace overlooking Hobart’s harbour.
